newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end higher on heavyweight buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end higher on heavyweight buying.

text.p: Jakarta share prices closed higher on Wednesday as the market received strong support from overseas buying of certain heavyweights, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index rose 6.53 points, or 0.96 percent, to close at 686.86 points after earlier touching an intra-day high of 687.86 points. Gainers led losers by 75 to 37, with 76 counters unchanged.
Total volume was 171.4 million shares on a turnover of 449.3 billion rupiah.
"In terms of volume, the market was moderate, but the rise in the index today was quite surprising. It's better than expected," a brokers with a London-based securities firm said.
Brokers said the market was likely to be slow on Thursday as it was the last trading day of the Jakarta bourse before the Eid al-Fitr holiday break until February 12.
They said the holiday in Hongkong and half-day trading in Singapore on Thursday preceeding the Lunar New Year could dampen overall market sentiment.
"Some profit taking might occur tomorrow ahead the two festivals this week," a broker with Hongkong based firm said.
She said the index would be mixed as some counters remained attractive and would receive strong buying interest after the release of some good 1996 earnings results.
Many foreign buyers targeted heavyweights Bank Negara Indonesia, Indosat, Tambang Timah, Telkom, Gudang Garam and Semen Gresik during the trading day, brokers said.
State-controlled Bank Negara Indonesia rose 25 rupiah to 1,600 rupiah on a turnover of 5.1 million shares. Brokers attributed the rise to a report that it will boost its working capital.
Telecommunications service provider Indosat rose 25 rupiah to 6,625 rupiah on a volume of 905,000 shares with brokers saying it was boosted by its good earnings announced in the morning.
Tin producer Tambang Timah rose 250 rupiah to 5,050 rupiah on a turnover of about four million shares after it announced its 1996 results on Tuesday.
